name: Todays Checkins
query:
select
	b.name as "Booking:Link/Resort Booking:150",
	b.guest as "Guest:Link/Guest:150",
	b.status as "Status::100",
	b.check_in as "Check-in:Date:100",
	b.grand_total as "Grand Total:Currency:120",
	b.balance_due as "Balance Due:Currency:120"
from `tabResort Booking` b
where b.check_in = CURDATE()
	and b.status in ('Pre-booked', 'Confirmed')
order by b.guest
